page.layout: One text column, full width. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature "Cc" below the last line, right of centre.

main_text.p: tus siquidem hoc tantum observat Va-lentinum Vnigenitum distinxisse à Ver-bo, Verbum à Christo, Christum à Iesu, idémque fecisse Basilidem, sed de Verbi à Monogene educatione penitus tacet. At Irenæus, inquit, de Basilide ita loquitur lib. 1 cap. 23. ostendit Nun primò ab Innato natum Patre, ab hoc autem natum Logon; fateor hæc de Basilide scripsisse Irenæum, hisque similia de eodem tradere Epipha-nium & Theodoretum, sed ista Viri docti causam minimè iuvant, nulla siquidem Siges fit mentio inter Basilidis figmenta, docebat quidem Basilides à Nu natum Lo-gon, sed à Nu & Sige emissum esse nusquam docuit; primus ex Gnosticis hoc af-feruit Valentinus, nullusque ante eum Logi ex Sige emanationem commentus est; Basilides, ait Pearsonius p. 65. & illi Gnostici inter quos ipse fuit, neque Bython neque Nun sine συζύγοις suis Æonem ullum pro-creâsse docuerunt[?]. Cùm hæc lego, vix ocu-lis meis credo, contraria prorsus à vetu-stioribus Ecclesiæ Scriptoribus edoctus; Nam Irenæus, Tertullianus, Philastrius, Epiphanius, Theodoretus, fabulosam Basilidis Theogoniam sic repræsentant; Nus ab Innato natus Patre, à Nu Logos, à Lo-go Phronesis, à Phronesi autem Sophia & Dy-namis, à Dynami & Sophiâ, virtutes, &c[?]

page.notes: The word "tus" at the top is a fragment carried over from the previous page. A stain covers the end of "docuerunt" and the start of "procreâsse"; the reading is doubtful. The Greek "συζύγοις" is small and faint, so its accents are doubtful. The final "&c" at the line end is partly unclear. The page number and running head are printed at the top. The signature "Cc" is at the foot.
